issue.description: Inconsistent types in `_DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_PATTERNS`: mixes plain strings with a compiled `re.Pattern` object (`_HIGH_ENTROPY_PATTERN`). Forces `_is_sensitive` to do `isinstance(pat, re.Pattern)` checks on every iteration.
issue.suggestion: Keep all patterns as strings at definition. Compile them once in `_load_sensitive_patterns_from_env` or at module initialization into a uniform list of compiled regexes.

issue.description: seal_audit_chain_with_connection is 48 lines with multiple responsibilities (locking, cursor management, batch processing, commit, cleanup)
issue.suggestion: Extract batch processing loop into separate function; separate lock acquisition/release into context manager; use 'with' statements for cursors

issue.description: Imports not grouped per PEP 8 (stdlib, third-party, local); missing blank lines between groups
issue.suggestion: Reorder imports: stdlib (sys, os, hashlib, logging, json, datetime, typing), then third-party (psycopg2), with blank line between groups

issue.description: Most public functions lack docstrings describing purpose, parameters, return values, and side effects
issue.suggestion: Add Google-style or NumPy-style docstrings to all public functions: get_last_chain_state, create_pending_cursor, fetch_pending_batches, compute_chain_hashes, insert_chain_links, seal_audit_chain_with_connection, seal_audit_chain, load_config

issue.description: load_config reads environment variables at module import time if called at module level; currently only called in main() but could be imported
issue.suggestion: Ensure load_config is only called at runtime (inside main), not at module level; current usage is compliant but fragile

issue.description: configure_logging adds handler to root logger every call; if called multiple times, duplicates log output
issue.suggestion: Check if handler already exists before adding, or use logging.basicConfig with force=True (Python 3.8+)

issue.description: sanitize_event allows 'metadata' field which may contain high-entropy tokens/secrets per Section 34. No entropy-based filtering implemented
issue.suggestion: Implement entropy detection for string values > 20 chars with high Shannon entropy. Redact or hash such values. Apply to all string fields recursively

issue.description: get_pending_events lacks ORDER BY clause, returning non-deterministic results. Should order by created_at for FIFO processing
issue.suggestion: Add ORDER BY created_at ASC to the SELECT query

issue.description: LOG_PATH is defined but never used in the module
issue.suggestion: Remove unused LOG_PATH constant or implement file logging configuration

issue.description: sanitize_payload has multiple responsibilities: validation, ID generation, timestamp, severity calculation, payload filtering
issue.suggestion: Split into validate_payload(), calculate_severity(), build_alert_record() functions

issue.description: intake_adapter handles parsing, sanitization, DB insertion, audit logging - violates single responsibility
issue.suggestion: Separate into parse_and_validate(), persist_alert(), audit_alert() functions

issue.description: Multiple CREATE INDEX statements execute on every _init_triage_table call (though IF NOT EXISTS adds overhead)
issue.suggestion: Move index creation to separate migration script or check if indexes exist before creating

issue.description: Hardcoded default paths assume specific Linux filesystem; difficult to test without volume mounts
issue.suggestion: Use platformdirs library or allow relative paths for development; document required env vars

issue.description: _audit_log uses append-only pattern correctly but doesn't include correlation_id for traceability across services
issue.suggestion: Add correlation_id parameter to _audit_log and intake_adapter for distributed tracing

issue.description: Magic numbers for exit codes (1, 2) in __main__ block without constants or documentation
issue.suggestion: Define EXIT_PARSE_ERROR = 2, EXIT_GENERAL_ERROR = 1 as module constants

issue.description: Regex pattern susceptible to ReDoS due to nested quantifiers in domain and URL patterns, risking CPU exhaustion on malicious input.
issue.suggestion: Simplify regex patterns or split into separate regexes per IOC type to avoid catastrophic backtracking.

issue.description: Redundant imports and constant definitions are repeated four times at the beginning of the file.
issue.suggestion: Remove the duplicate blocks of code (lines 1-60) and keep only one set of imports and constants.

issue.description: The severity levels in the SQL CHECK constraint are hardcoded, creating a maintenance burden if the Python constants change.
issue.suggestion: Dynamically generate the SQL CHECK constraint string using the defined severity constants.

issue.description: Missing return type annotation for the function.
issue.suggestion: Add return type annotation: def rollback_plan() -> None:

issue.description: Global _SESSION and _LOGGER_CACHE prevent proper unit testing isolation. Tests cannot reset state between runs, leading to flaky tests and shared connection pools
issue.suggestion: Refactor to a class-based adapter (TheHiveWritebackAdapter) with session and logger as instance attributes. Provide factory function for backward compatibility

issue.description: run_sanitization_tests() embedded in production code. Test functions belong in test files, not the main module. Increases attack surface and module size
issue.suggestion: Move tests to tests/test_thehive_writeback.py. Keep only the --test-sanitization CLI entry point that imports and runs external test suite

issue.description: verify_sanitization() calls json.dumps(payload) for every pattern check (8 patterns), creating 8 string copies of the payload. For large payloads this allocates unnecessary memory
issue.suggestion: Serialize once before the loop: payload_str = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False). Then iterate patterns against the single string

issue.description: __main__ block calls sys.exit() directly. While in __main__ this is acceptable, the blueprint prefers raise RuntimeError for library code. The main() function correctly returns exit codes
issue.suggestion: Keep as-is since this is the CLI entry point. No change needed - this is compliant for executable scripts

issue.description: main() return type Union[str, int] is ambiguous. Callers must check isinstance(result, str) vs int. Better to raise exceptions for errors and return case_id on success
issue.suggestion: Change main() to raise specific exceptions (ValidationError, TheHiveAPIError, NetworkError) and return str case_id. Let CLI wrapper handle exit codes. Or use a Result type

issue.description: lru_cache on database-backed function makes unit testing difficult (cache persists across tests)
issue.suggestion: Remove cache or add cache_clear() method for test isolation; prefer explicit caching with TTL

issue.description: On batch flush failure, all failed entries re-queued at front causing repeated retries of same failing batch
issue.suggestion: Implement exponential backoff or dead-letter queue for repeatedly failing entries

issue.description: Unused import: 'functools' is imported but only used for lru_cache which should be removed
issue.suggestion: Remove functools import if lru_cache is removed from validate_approval_token

issue.description: Trigger audit_proposals_insert uses NEW.changed_by but INSERT doesn't set changed_by in trigger context
issue.suggestion: Verify NEW.changed_by is available in AFTER INSERT trigger; SQLite provides NEW.* for all columns

issue.description: Casting entire embedding array to float32 after encoding creates unnecessary memory copy; SentenceTransformer.encode() supports output_value='float32' parameter to avoid this
issue.suggestion: Pass convert_to_numpy=True, output_value='float32' to model.encode() and remove the astype call

issue.description: _encode and _encode_batch are redundant thin wrappers around _encode_internal adding unnecessary indirection; _encode_internal already handles both str and List[str] inputs
issue.suggestion: Remove _encode and _encode_batch methods; call _encode_internal directly from embed_document, embed_query, embed_documents, embed_queries

issue.description: Duplicate dry_run logic in archive_partition (lines 78-81), archive_partition_with_connection (lines 115-120), and run_retention (lines 163-175). Violates DRY, increases bug surface.
issue.suggestion: Extract dry-run logging to a helper function _log_dry_run(partition_name, archive_base). Call from single location in run_retention before dispatching.

issue.description: Inefficient partition filtering: fetches all iocs_* tables from pg_class, then re-filters in Python with duplicate date parsing. SQL already computes to_date() but results discarded.
issue.suggestion: Move all filtering to SQL: SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relname ~ '^iocs_\d{4}_\d{2}_\d{2}$' AND to_date(substring(relname from 6), 'YYYY_MM_DD') < %s. Remove Python-side loop.

issue.description: Creates new PostgreSQL connection per partition in parallel workers. High overhead for many partitions. No connection pooling.
issue.suggestion: Use psycopg2.pool.ThreadedConnectionPool or pass a connection factory. Reuse connections within worker threads. Limit pool size to max_workers.

issue.description: Module-level side effect: _load_config() modifies global variables. Called from main() but globals are mutable state. Violates blueprint v11.7 'no module-level side effects' and makes testing unreliable.
issue.suggestion: Return config dict from _load_config() instead of mutating globals. Pass config to functions that need it. Keep module-level constants as true constants (fallback defaults only).

issue.description: _query_template defined inside archive_partition() but is constant. Recreated on every call.
issue.suggestion: Move to module-level constant: COPY_QUERY_TEMPLATE = 'COPY (SELECT * FROM {table}) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT JSON);'

issue.description: run_retention() does too much: validation, mount check, DB query, partition filtering, dry-run logging, parallel execution. Violates single responsibility.
issue.suggestion: Split into: get_partitions_to_archive(), execute_archive_plan(), run_retention() as orchestrator. Improves testability and readability.

issue.description: Module-level global state (_DEFAULT_POOL, _DEFAULT_POOL_FACTORY) creates hidden dependencies and makes unit testing difficult
issue.suggestion: Encapsulate in a class with dependency injection, or provide a context manager for pool lifecycle. At minimum, add 'reset_default_pool()' call in test fixtures

issue.description: _compute_query_hash formats each float to 8 decimal places with f-string, creating unnecessary string allocations for large embeddings
issue.suggestion: Use struct.pack for binary representation: 'import struct; embedding_bytes = struct.pack(f"{len(query_embedding)}d", *query_embedding)' then hash bytes directly

issue.description: _log_audit uses broad exception handling that violates 'no silent failures' principle from blueprint reliability requirements
issue.suggestion: Replace bare except with specific exception types and add structured logging. At minimum log the error with context before continuing

issue.description: stitch_memory_context function exceeds 50 lines and handles connection management, query execution, formatting, and audit logging - violates single responsibility
issue.suggestion: Extract '_execute_similarity_query', '_format_context_blocks', and '_build_metadata' helper functions to improve readability and testability

issue.description: _log_audit has 7 parameters, making callsites verbose and error-prone; audit_context parameter lacks type hint
issue.suggestion: Create a dataclass AuditLogEntry with all fields, or use **kwargs with TypedDict for audit_context

issue.description: List comprehension with f-string for each result creates intermediate strings; could use StringIO for large result sets
issue.suggestion: For MAX_TOP_K=100 this is negligible, but consider 'io.StringIO' for consistency if top_k limit increases

issue.description: set_default_pool_factory and reset_default_pool manipulate global state without thread safety, risky for concurrent test execution
issue.suggestion: Add threading.Lock for global state mutations, or use contextvars for context-local pool overrides in async environments

issue.description: File uses psycopg2 (PostgreSQL) not sqlite3, so AMEND-65 (no mocking sqlite3.Connection) is not applicable - but should verify no sqlite3 usage exists
issue.suggestion: Confirm no sqlite3 imports or usage in codebase; this file is compliant as it uses psycopg2 exclusively

issue.description: SQL query selects specific columns but uses positional row access (row['adapter_id']) which is fragile to schema changes; should use named access consistently
issue.suggestion: Already using row['column_name'] which is correct for sqlite3.Row; no change needed but verify row_factory is always set (it is in _connection)

issue.description: Violates blueprint requirement for specific error handling: generic Exception catch should be replaced with specific exception types
issue.suggestion: Replace bare except Exception with except (FileNotFoundError, PermissionError, yaml.YAMLError, OSError) as e

issue.description: Cache keyed by task_type but multiple task_types may map to same adapter_id, causing redundant database queries
issue.suggestion: Add secondary cache keyed by adapter_id, or normalize cache to store by adapter_id and lookup task_type->adapter_id mapping separately

issue.description: main() function is 47 lines and handles argument parsing, git validation, tag discovery, commit enumeration, changelog parsing, and result reporting - violates single responsibility
issue.suggestion: Extract git operations into a GitRepo class, changelog parsing into ChangelogParser class, and keep main() as orchestration only

issue.description: Module docstring documents EXIT_ENV_ERROR (3) for 'not a Git repository' but main() returns this only for missing .git or git command not found, not for invalid repo state
issue.suggestion: Update docstring to match actual behavior or enhance validation to match docstring

issue.description: Module-level sys.exit() call in __main__ block violates 'No sys.exit()/exit() in library code — use raise RuntimeError() [AMEND-64]' and 'No module-level side effects (file I/O, network, exit calls) [v11.7]'. While acceptable for standalone CLI scripts, the blueprint prohibits this pattern.
issue.suggestion: Wrap CLI entry in a function and let the caller handle exit, or raise RuntimeError with exit code as attribute for the wrapper to handle.

issue.description: create_mock_gpu_xml() hardcodes 'MiB' units in mock XML. If parse_mem_value() is updated to handle multiple units, the mock will not test those code paths, creating a testing gap.
issue.suggestion: Parameterize the unit in create_mock_gpu_xml() or make it match the unit parsing logic in parse_mem_value().

issue.description: get_gpu_info() parses entire nvidia-smi XML output even though only fb_memory_usage is needed. For systems with many GPUs, this wastes CPU and memory parsing unused data.
issue.suggestion: Use nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.total,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits for lighter output, or use pynvml library for direct API access.

issue.description: Docstring for `embed_document` contains an incomplete doctest example: `>>> svc = EmbeddingServ` cuts off mid-class-name. This will cause doctest failures and looks unprofessional.
issue.suggestion: Complete the example: `>>> svc = EmbeddingService(lambda t: [0.0]*768)`

issue.description: Type hint `Sequence[float]` for encoder return type is less specific than the actual `list[float]` returned by `fake_encode` and expected by the service methods. While compatible, using `list[float]` would be more precise and enable better static analysis.
issue.suggestion: Change encoder type hint to `Callable[[str], list[float]]` since the service converts to list anyway with `list(vector)`.

issue.description: The `__main__` block configures logging and raises RuntimeError on failure. While acceptable for a CLI entry point, the blueprint discourages exit-like behavior in library code. This file serves dual purpose as both library and CLI tool.
issue.suggestion: Consider separating the CLI entry point into a separate script, or document that this module is intended as a CLI tool first. The current approach is reasonable for a CI gate script.

issue.description: Test case generators (get_doc_test_cases, get_query_test_cases) depend on module-level REQUIRED_DOC_PREFIX/REQUIRED_QUERY_PREFIX which are loaded at import time - stale values if config changes
issue.suggestion: Pass prefixes as parameters to test case generators, or generate test cases inside main() after loading current prefixes.

issue.description: Unused import: Optional from typing is imported but never used
issue.suggestion: Remove 'Optional' from typing import.

issue.description: validate_against_service() has no retry logic for transient network failures - single timeout=5 attempt
issue.suggestion: Add retry logic with exponential backoff (e.g., 3 attempts with 1s, 2s, 4s delays) for transient network issues.

issue.description: main() function is doing too much: validation, test selection, execution, reporting - violates single responsibility
issue.suggestion: Extract test execution into run_tests(test_cases) -> bool, validation into separate function, reporting into separate function.

issue.description: main() function is 58 lines and handles argument parsing, config loading, session management, parallel execution, and result aggregation
issue.suggestion: Extract config loading, session creation, and result processing into separate functions for single responsibility

issue.description: validate_config() validates forbidden_method against VALID_METHODS but doesn't normalize case before comparison
issue.suggestion: Normalize forbidden_method to uppercase before validation: cfg['forbidden_method'].upper() in VALID_METHODS (already done on line 52 but not stored back)

issue.description: ThreadPoolExecutor created with max_workers based on config size but no consideration for connection pool limits
issue.suggestion: Configure requests.Session with HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=max_workers, pool_maxsize=max_workers) to match worker count

issue.description: sys.exit() used in library code violates AMEND-64; should raise RuntimeError instead
issue.suggestion: Replace sys.exit(main()) with: try: raise RuntimeError(main()) except RuntimeError as e: sys.exit(e.args[0]) if isinstance(e.args[0], int) else 1

issue.description: Random sleep durations inside lock create non-deterministic test timing, making CI flaky and slowing down test execution
issue.suggestion: Use fixed minimal delays or remove sleeps entirely for unit tests; reserve variable latency for integration tests with real I/O

issue.description: Constants like MIN_LOCK_ACQUISITION_MS and MAX_LOCK_ACQUISITION_MULTIPLIER are magic numbers without clear rationale
issue.suggestion: Add docstrings explaining the purpose and expected range of each constant; consider grouping into a Config dataclass

issue.description: worker function lacks return type annotation and mutates external list; functional style with return value would be cleaner
issue.suggestion: Change signature to return Optional[int] and let executor.collect() gather results: def worker(ledger) -> Optional[int]: ... return idx

issue.description: The functions verify_chain_streaming and verify_chain contain nearly identical logic, violating DRY principle.
issue.suggestion: Refactor the verification logic into a single function that takes an iterable of chain entries. Then, verify_chain_streaming can use ijson to create an iterable, and verify_chain can pass the list directly.

issue.description: Fragile path construction using __file__.
issue.suggestion: Derive file paths relative to the PROJECT_ROOT constant rather than __file__ to ensure consistency regardless of the execution context or symlink usage.

issue.description: The script prints error messages to stdout instead of stderr, which is non-standard for CI/CD tooling and can interfere with log parsing.
issue.suggestion: Use 'print(..., file=sys.stderr)' for all error messages.

issue.description: The 'computed_hash' variable is calculated but never used, leading to unnecessary performance overhead and confusing code.
issue.suggestion: Remove the unused hash calculation or integrate it into the integrity verification logic.

issue.description: load_config function lacks validation for configuration values (e.g., stale_threshold_seconds must be positive, manifest_filename must be safe string).
issue.suggestion: Add validation in load_config: ensure stale_threshold_seconds > 0, and validate manifest_filename is non-empty and contains no path separators (or sanitize via basename).

issue.description: Docstring claims function queries local message broker status in production, but implementation only checks a log file, causing confusion.
issue.suggestion: Update docstring to accurately describe that the function verifies recovery logic by checking for a pattern in a local manifest log file.

issue.description: The entropy calculation is performed on every token regardless of length, which is inefficient for short tokens that cannot mathematically exceed the threshold.
issue.suggestion: Add a guard clause to skip entropy calculation for tokens shorter than 23 characters, as they cannot mathematically reach an entropy of 4.5.

issue.description: The script uses sys.exit() in the __main__ block, which is acceptable for a script but violates the spirit of the blueprint if this file is intended to be imported as a library.
issue.suggestion: Refactor the __main__ block to call a function that returns an exit code, and keep the sys.exit() call strictly at the entry point level.

issue.description: The code lacks type hints for function arguments and return values, reducing maintainability and clarity.
issue.suggestion: Add PEP 484 type hints to all functions, especially for the tokenization and entropy calculation logic.

issue.description: sys.exit(main()) in __main__ block violates AMEND-64 'No sys.exit()/exit() in library code — use raise RuntimeError()'; though this is a CLI script, the pattern should use raise SystemExit or return codes
issue.suggestion: Replace sys.exit(main()) with: raise SystemExit(main()) or keep as-is but document why CLI entry point is exempt

issue.description: load_forbidden_fields missing return type hint (should be Set[str])
issue.suggestion: Add return type annotation: def load_forbidden_fields(...) -> Set[str]:

issue.description: validate_meta_schema missing return type hint (should be List[str])
issue.suggestion: Add return type annotation: def validate_meta_schema(data: Any) -> List[str]:

issue.description: find_forbidden missing return type hint (should be List[str])
issue.suggestion: Add return type annotation: def find_forbidden(obj: Any, forbidden_fields: Set[str]) -> List[str]:

issue.description: validate_schema missing return type hint (should be int)
issue.suggestion: Add return type annotation: def validate_schema(schema_path: str, forbidden_fields: Optional[Set[str]] = None) -> int:

issue.description: check_ci_context missing return type hint (should be None)
issue.suggestion: Add return type annotation: def check_ci_context() -> None:

issue.description: main missing return type hint (should be int)
issue.suggestion: Add return type annotation: def main() -> int:

issue.description: Redaction string `'[REDACTED]'` hardcoded in `redact()` method. Not configurable for different redaction styles (masking, partial, custom tokens).
issue.suggestion: Add `redaction_token: str = '[REDACTED]'` parameter to `Sanitizer.__init__()` and `redact()` method. Store as instance attribute `self._redaction_token`.

issue.description: Global `_default_sanitizer` creates shared mutable state. Concurrent modifications to default patterns affect all callers. Not thread-safe for pattern updates.
issue.suggestion: Remove global singleton. Require explicit `Sanitizer()` instantiation. If singleton needed, use `@lru_cache` on a factory function or document thread-safety requirements.

issue.description: Global _DEFAULTS_CACHE and reset_defaults_cache() create module-level mutable state, making parallel testing difficult and violating blueprint guidance against module-level side effects
issue.suggestion: Encapsulate configuration in a class or pass config dict explicitly through call chain; remove global cache

issue.description: Validation steps defined as lambdas in list but then handled with special-case if/elif branches; lambdas for steps 3-6 are never used, creating confusing dead code
issue.suggestion: Simplify to direct function calls in sequence, or use a uniform step function signature that accepts (config_path, data, params)

issue.description: sys.exit(main()) in __main__ block violates AMEND-64 "No sys.exit()/exit() in library code" though this is a CLI entry point
issue.suggestion: Replace with raise SystemExit(main()) or keep as-is with justification comment; blueprint primarily targets library code

issue.description: validate_partition_config re-parses JSON file in each check function when data=None (defensive default), though main flow passes data; redundant I/O if functions called independently
issue.suggestion: Remove data=None defaults and require data parameter, or document that callers must pass parsed data

issue.description: _check_json_parsing re-opens and re-parses file on every call; called once in main flow but available for repeated calls
issue.suggestion: Accept pre-parsed data as required parameter; remove default None and re-parse logic

issue.description: Line-by-line scanning with regex per line is inefficient for large files; repeated regex compilation overhead
issue.suggestion: Read file in chunks or entirety; use single COMPILED_COMBINED.finditer() on full content

issue.description: Dry-run payloads hardcoded in _generate_dry_run_payloads(); test values resemble real credentials and could trigger false alerts in other tools
issue.suggestion: Generate payloads programmatically using clearly invalid patterns (e.g., 'INVALID_AKIA...', 'TEST_GHP_...') or use a test fixture file

issue.description: scan_text docstring claims to raise re.error and TypeError but function doesn't explicitly raise re.error (regex is pre-compiled)
issue.suggestion: Update docstring to reflect actual behavior; remove re.error from raises since COMPILED_COMBINED is module-level constant

issue.description: sys.exit() in __main__ block is acceptable but ScanExit inherits from RuntimeError per AMEND-64; consider using SystemExit for CLI entry point
issue.suggestion: Change ScanExit to inherit from SystemExit or keep as-is since it's caught and converted to sys.exit(); current approach is compliant

issue.description: scan_directory uses path.rglob('*') which traverses all files including .git, __pycache__, node_modules; wastes I/O
issue.suggestion: Add exclude patterns for common VCS/build directories; use path.rglob with filter or os.walk with pruning

issue.description: ALLOWLIST_SHA256 and ALLOWLIST_UUID are separate sets but combined into ALLOWLIST; no documentation on why these specific hashes/UUIDs are allowed
issue.suggestion: Add comments explaining each allowlist entry origin; consider loading from external config file for maintainability

issue.description: PATTERNS dict uses raw strings but some patterns lack raw prefix (though not required here); inconsistent style
issue.suggestion: Add 'r' prefix to all regex patterns for consistency and to avoid future escape sequence issues
